Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
-- =============================================================================
-- Author:              chengguo.liu@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2025-01-09
-- Theme Domain:        Shopeefood Dish Category
-- Data Granularity:    dish_id
-- Description:         shopeefood vn dish category dimension table
-- Documents:           
-- =============================================================================
--  Version History:
--  2025-01-09 - chengguo.liu - 初始化
-- =============================================================================

--drop table if exists ${SCHEMA}.dwd_risk_vn_shopeefood_mart_dim_vn_dish_category_da_df;
create external table if not exists ${SCHEMA}.dwd_risk_vn_shopeefood_mart_dim_vn_dish_category_da_df
(
    dish_id bigint comment 'dish id'
    ,dish_name string comment 'dish name'
    ,cate_l1_id bigint comment 'category level 1 id'
    ,cate_l1_name string comment 'category level 1 name'
    ,cate_l2_id bigint comment 'category level 2 id'
    ,cate_l2_name string comment 'category level 2 name'
    ,cate_l3_id bigint comment 'category level 3 id'
    ,cate_l3_name string comment 'category level 3 name'
    ,foody_service_id bigint comment 'foody service id'
    ,store_id bigint comment 'store id'
)
comment 'risk shopeefood vn dish category dimension table'
partitioned by
(
    grass_date string comment 'partition key, yyyy-MM-dd'
)
stored as orc tblproperties ("orc.compress"="zstd")
location '${HDFS_PATH}/risk_feature/dwd/dwd_risk_vn_shopeefood_mart_dim_vn_dish_category_da_df/grass_region=VN';
--msck repair table ${SCHEMA}.dwd_risk_vn_shopeefood_mart_dim_vn_dish_category_da_df;


insert overwrite table ${SCHEMA}.dwd_risk_vn_shopeefood_mart_dim_vn_dish_category_da_df partition (grass_date)
select
    dish_id
    ,dish_name
    ,cate_l1_id
    ,cate_l1_name
    ,cate_l2_id
    ,cate_l2_name
    ,cate_l3_id
    ,cate_l3_name
    ,foody_service_id
    ,store_id
    ,'${grass_date}' as grass_date
from shopeefood.shopeefood_mart_dim_vn_dish_category_da
where dt = '${grass_date}'
;
